The download is immediate, so the trigger point is unclear. An implementer cannot tell whether to emit the event per request, before or after the response completes, or not at all. → State the emitting call site and trigger (e.g. "after the export response completes, publish export-ready with {user_id, url: /widgets/export.csv}"), or state that widgets emits nothing new and mailer consumes an existing emission. Add a test asserting the emission, or its absence. — probed: none
- [minor] oversimplification @ Design: "Read widgets in id order in batches of 1000" — The spec does not say whether the response is streamed or buffered, or what happens if a batch read fails after headers and partial rows are sent. A truncated but well-formed-looking CSV is possible. → Choose buffered or streamed. If streamed, state the failure behavior (e.g. abort the connection so the client sees an incomplete download rather than a silently short file). — probed: none
